name: Anna Freud
shortBio: Austrian-British psychoanalyst who systematized ego psychology, mapped the repertoire of psychological defense mechanisms, and pioneered developmental child analysis.
centralQuestion: How does the ego deploy unconscious defensive mechanisms to mediate between instinctual id impulses, the superego, and external reality?

keyWorks.title: The Ego and the Mechanisms of Defence
keyWorks.description: Foundational text classifying and explaining ego defenses such as repression, regression, and identification with the aggressor.

keyWorks.title: Normality and Pathology in Childhood
keyWorks.description: Formulates the diagnostic concept of developmental lines from dependency to emotional self-reliance.

keyWorks.title: The Psychoanalytic Treatment of Children
keyWorks.description: Clinical lectures detailing technical principles and preparatory phases in child psychoanalysis.
